external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A person who browses and orders socks through the mobile app and receives fax confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Sokify's mobile application used by customers to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: API used by the mobile app; it stores customer information, receives orders, and is modified by spreadsheet macros.
processes.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS
processes.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: Sokify's stock and inventory system that receives orders and handles dispatch information.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS, our stock and inventory system

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: Gateway that sends dispatch confirmations by fax to the customer.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
processes.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

processes.name: spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API
processes.notes: It was a stopgap and it is still here.

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: Database containing customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: Flat file containing delivery addresses associated with orders.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: Spreadsheet containing the product catalogue and used by marketing to change prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: talks to API
data_flows.description: Mobile app interaction with the web API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: keep customers
data_flows.description: Web API storing customer records in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer name, address, and payment card

data_flows.name: hand order
data_flows.description: Web API handing an order to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writing a delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sending a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: Fax gateway sending the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.name: change catalogue
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros sending SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: The office location where the marketing laptop and catalogue spreadsheet are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The user database is confidential because it contains customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains customer name, address, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses and nothing else.
